interface.title: DNA Mutation Predictor (DNA Mutation Effect Predictor, ESM-2 + XGBoost)
interface.field: Human genetics / clinical variant interpretation (missense variant pathogenicity)
interface.stage_of_work: Variant triage and prioritisation, before experimental or clinical follow-up; also checking how far to trust the model
interface.what_it_is_for: Score missense variants as pathogenic or benign, one at a time (gene symbol + HGVSp) or from a CSV, using ESM-2 protein-language-model embeddings and an XGBoost classifier, and review the model's held-out performance.

data.source: built-in example variants plus an uploaded test file
data.note: Inputs were the built-in example variants (the Home 'Try It Now' cards and the Predict page's quick-example buttons), variants typed by hand, the app's own sample CSV template (sample_variants.csv: TP53 C61G, KRAS G12V, BRCA1 G1738R, PTEN R130Q; downloaded but not uploaded), and the test file variants_batch_sample.csv (8 rows, including NOTAREALGENE, the malformed p.Xyz9999Gly and PTEN with no hgvsp). The sandbox has no outbound network, so the UniProt lookup failed and no prediction ever finished. Every single prediction gave 'Prediction failed: UniProt ID not found for gene TP53'. Every batch row came back as 'Error' with empty probability columns. The Performance and About pages are fully offline (data/metrics.json) and worked. According to the Performance page text, the web app scores with ESM-2 only and the population blend is CLI-only, so the evo2_prob and evo2_llr batch columns are not expected to fill in the web app.

features.name: Example cards that prefill the analysis form

Both set the GENE SYMBOL and HGVSp fields and switch the sidebar radio to Predict. The button labels render white on white, so they look blank.

screens_never_reached: Predict result view (pathogenicity probability gauge, Pathogenic/Benign label): every classification failed with 'UniProt ID not found' because the sandbox has no outbound network
Residue-level ±128 window view and the AlphaFold 3D structure view coloured by distance from the mutation site: they only render after a successful prediction, which never happened
Evo2 DNA-level blended opinion (evo2_prob / evo2_llr): appears only as empty columns in the batch results
Batch results with real probabilities, ranked or flagged: every row came back 'Error'
not_done: Goal 1 (triage a single variant): stopped at the error banner. No probability was produced because the UniProt lookup needs network access.
Goal 2 (compare TP53 R175H with the benign TP53 R50Q): both ran, but both failed the same way, so calibration could not be compared.
Goal 3 (residue-window and AlphaFold 3D inspection): unreachable without a successful prediction.

Goal 4 (batch screen to a ranked shortlist): upload, run and download all worked, but every row was 'Error' and the results grid has no error-reason column. Unknown gene, malformed HGVSp and missing hgvsp were not told apart from network failures, so validation behaviour could not be judged. Apart from sorting the grid, no ranking or flagging control was seen, so the shortlist step could not be done in the UI.
I did not upload the downloaded sample_variants.csv template: only variants_batch_sample.csv is available as an upload file.

ROC 'Download plot as a PNG': the explorer's trace and kept screens do not record this download (screens/032.webp shows hovers and the legend toggle, not a download), so it was removed from t11. The replay did save plot-image.png, so the feature step stays in f5.
Data grid 'Download as CSV' (on the About stack table) produced no file in the replay, and Fullscreen was never tried.

The decorative Home 'DNA Double Helix' Plotly 3D plot: I pressed ▶ ROTATE (it animated and zoomed) and clicked one legend entry with no visible effect. It doesn't connect to any analysis, so I left it out of the tree and features.

UI note: the 'Analyze →' buttons, quick-example buttons and download buttons show as blank white boxes (their labels are hidden by the theme). Navigating away from Batch clears the uploaded file, and downloading predictions.csv clears the results panel.
